gaps.need: Primary source-backed decision rule distinguishing Fisher exact from chi-square for sparse contingency tables.
gaps.reason: Current corpus source extracted for chi-square provides expected-count conditions but does not provide a sufficiently explicit Fisher-exact decision rule in the extracted text.

resolution.note: NIST explicitly supports Fisher exact for small independent-sample 2x2 discrete data; Penn State independently states Fisher exact may be used when large-sample two-proportion approximation assumptions are not met.
